objective: Establish the first executable repaired-branch world-model-train plus low-dimensional MPC-eval reference point under the recovered Kaggle backend.
notes: This is an execution and measurement reference run, not a final benchmark.

retry_chain.summary: World-model smoke training completed remotely, but low-dimensional evaluation failed because robomimic 0.3.0 rejected the unexpected keyword argument use_image_obj in create_env_from_metadata.

Dataset download, regression tests, and world-model smoke training passed remotely, but low-dimensional evaluation failed because the Kaggle dependency resolution loaded a robomimic stack that still imports mujoco_py under Python 3.12.

A pure version pin to robomimic >= 0.4.0 failed before runtime because Kaggle's PyPI view only exposed robomimic 0.1.0, 0.2.0, and 0.3.0. The next retry must follow the upstream source-install path instead of relying on PyPI.

The upstream source-install path produced a viable modern runtime with robomimic 0.4.0 and robosuite 1.5.1, but that stack downloaded low_dim_v15.hdf5 instead of the frozen-protocol low_dim_v141.hdf5. The next retry should use source tags aligned with the v141 dataset family.

The v141-aligned source tags restored the correct dataset family, passed regression tests, enabled CUDA, and completed world-model smoke training, but low-dimensional rollout still failed because robomimic.env_robosuite imports mujoco_py. The next retry should bypass that wrapper and construct the robosuite environment directly from dataset env_args.

Direct robosuite environment construction cleared the mujoco_py blocker, but robosuite 1.4.1 rejected the lite_physics keyword. The next retry should remove that one incompatible argument and keep everything else frozen.

With the lite_physics keyword removed, direct robosuite construction progressed into controller initialization. The first truthful remaining blocker is a MuJoCo runtime mismatch: robosuite 1.4.1 expects the older DeepMind MuJoCo 2.3.x API, but the project metadata still allowed newer MuJoCo 3.x.

Pinning MuJoCo backward to 2.3.x is not viable on Kaggle's Python 3.12 runtime because pip falls back to a source build of mujoco 2.3.7 and fails before rollout. The direct robosuite.make reconstruction path is therefore retired in favor of the exact robomimic create_env_from_metadata / EnvRobosuite path with a minimal local mujoco_py compatibility stub.
